paragraphs: Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 34:8, reporting in the name of R' Levi. Hyman says it should undoubtedly read R' Yehudah son of R' Simon.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: ויק״ר פל״ד־ח is read as Vayikra Rabbah chapter 34 section 8, without independently checked edition. אמר בשם is running source description, not a newly claimed verbatim quotation.
בל״ס expresses without-doubt, and צ״ל should-read. Hyman’s confidence is preserved without converting his emendation into an independently attested variant.
Heading Yehoshua bar Simon differs from proposed Yehudah son of R' Simon, including the father-title component. All four personal title abbreviations remain R'.
